text:
riley (DevEx): Heads-up, onboarding samplekit blocked by semver guard. typegen bumped generated package from 0.9.2 -> 0.10.0 after regendiff. cc @toby @sana
toby (Eng): can you paste the regendiff? is it an API change or just formatting?
sana (SDK): looks non-functional: comment tweak + example key renamed snake_case->camelCase in openapi examples. diff excerpt:
```
-  - created_at
+  - createdAt
-    description: "example event // old note"
+    description: "example event // minor edit"
```
That caused codegen to reorder fields; typegen saw textual diffs and generated a changelog entry -> semver bump.
release-bot: [publish] blocked: semver-check failed (0.9.2 -> 0.10.0)
toby (Eng): short-term: i'll open PR to pin generated version in samplekit/package.json to 0.9.2 and add a regen-lint CI step that fails when regendiff non-empty.
sana (SDK): long-term: plan to update typegen to ignore comment-only/whitespace hunks when assembling changelog entries and to use deterministic enum/property ordering. drafting PR now.
riley (DevEx): great. once patch merged i'll rerun onboarding flow and confirm publish. will also add a one-line note in the onboarding checklist about this case.
